referenceSources.description:
A striking red Porsche 964 Cup race car, numbered 27, stands poised on a smooth racetrack surface beneath a cloudy sky. Sponsor logos from Blaupunkt, Recaro, Shell, Pirelli, and Johnson Matthey adorn its flanks, while a prominent rear wing and wide racing wheels hint at its competitive pedigree. Safety fencing and trackside banners for Porter Group and MEL Networks frame the scene, evoking the atmosphere of a professional racing venue.

Originally built as chassis number 9 of 49 for the first 911 Carrera Cup Series, this 1990 model has logged 33,251 kilometres and retains its original European racing livery. It has competed at iconic circuits including Nürburgring, Monza, Spa, Bathurst, and the Gold Coast Indy. Fully compliant with Motorsport New Zealand regulations, the car features a Matter roll-cage, original aluminium bonnet, and three sets of wheels, including rare magnesium fitments. Street legal and registered in New Zealand since 1996, it has been campaigned by notable drivers such as Jonny Reid and comes with complete ONS-Wagenpass documentation.
